/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'

const base = 'http://localhost:3100'
const pageCases = [
  ['/', 200, 'Welcome to My Blog'],
  ['/blog', 200, 'All Blog Posts'],
  ['/blog/1', 200, 'Comments (5)'],
  ['/blog/11', 200, 'Comments (5)'],
  ['/blog/999999', 404, '404 - Page Not Found'],
  ['/missing', 404, '404 - Page Not Found'],
]
for (const [path, expectedStatus, expectedText] of pageCases) {
  const response = await fetch(base + path)
  const body = await response.text()
  assert.equal(response.status, expectedStatus, "'`${path}: status`)
  assert.ok(body.includes(expectedText), `${path}: content`)
  console.log(`${path}: ${response.status}`)
}

const apiCases = [
  ['"'/api/posts', { method: 'GET' }, 200, data => Array.isArray(data) && data.length === 2],
  ['/api/posts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ title: 'New', content: 'Body' }) }, 201, data => data.title === 'New'],
  ['/api/posts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ title: '' }) }, 400, data => Boolean(data.error)],
  ['/api/posts/5', { method: 'GET' }, 200, data => data.id === 5],
  ['/api/posts/5', { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ title: 'Updated' }) }, 200, data => data.title === 'Updated'],
  ['/api/posts/5', { method: 'DELETE' }, 200, data => data.message.includes('5')],
  ['/api/posts', { method: 'PATCH' }, 405, () => true],
]
for (const [path, init, expectedStatus, check] of apiCases) {
  const response = await fetch(base + path, init)
  const body = response.status === 405 ? null : await response.json()
  assert.equal(response.status, expectedStatus, "'`${path} ${init.method}: status`)
  assert.ok(check(body), `${path} ${init.method}: body`)
  console.log(`${path} ${init.method}: ${response.status}`)
}
EOF'
